{{Quote|The Great Hunt is upon us! Many will hunt. Many will die. All will win glory and honor!|[[Huntmaster (Wookiee)|The Huntmaster]]|<ref name="TOR:TH">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Huntmaster|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a '''new edition''' of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] was started, a competition held for hunters across the galaxy.
However this time was a deadly match between [[Hunter (individual)|Braden's protégé]] and the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] turned [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Tarro Blood]].

==Qualifications==
{{Quote|For all you overblown, useless, no-talent cowards, we installed a handy exit door. Use it now. The rest of you--the real hunters--go see your handlers. They'll get you oriented to the planet and assign you three unique bounties. Everyone who takes down all three of their bounties wins a spot in the final melee. Anyone who doesn't get all three is out.|Huntmaster Assistant [[Lek]]|<ref name="TOR:TH" />}}
First the Hunter faced and killed a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] fugitive named [[Vexx]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] but Tarro at the same time killed most of Braden's team, depriving the Hunter of the support needed to enter the Great Hunt.<ref name="TOR:TLF">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Last Flight|Hutta}}</ref> The Hunter managed to win sponsorship from [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="TOR:MS">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|My Sponsorship|Hutta}}</ref> despite proxies sent by Blood.<ref name="TOR:SA">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Settling Accounts|Hutta}}</ref>

[[File:Grand_Melee.png|thumb|left|280px|The Grand Melee]]
Arriving on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], capital of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Hunter and [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], last surviving member of Braden's team, met up with their contact at the [[Mandalorian enclave]], [[Crysta Markon]],<ref name="TOR:THoDK">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Hunt on Dromund Kaas|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> who sent them on bounties across the planet to earn a spot in the final melee.<ref name="TOR:TH" /> But again, Blood continued to interfere by dispatching freelance Imperial mercenaries<ref name="TOR:AMT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|A Musty Trail|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> and later claimed that the Hunter died within the [[Dark Temple]]. Ultimately, the Hunter managed to win the [[Grand Melee]] and became a Great Hunt competitor. Blood attempted to denounce the Hunter but the [[Huntmaster]] had already made his decision. Enraged that he could not get his enemy disqualified, Blood promised to see the Hunter dead.<ref name="TOR:TM" />

===The Great Hunt===
{{Quote|The Great Hunt proves talent, resolve. Mandalore calls it to bring him the most skilled hunter in the galaxy. Each hunter will hunt the other's prey. Then each hunter hunts the other. At the end, there is no prey and only one hunter.|[[Huntmaster (Wookiee)|The Huntmaster]]|<ref name="TOR:TM" />}}
Crysta then instructed the Hunter to steal a [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|D5-Mantis Patrol Craft]] from the spaceport, but Blood had alerted the port authorities to the upcoming theft. But not even that could stop the Hunter, who killed the Imperials and the ship's [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Unidentified smuggler (Dromund Kaas)|owner]].<ref name="TOR:JR">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Joy Ride|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

====Balmorra====
[[File:Ivernus.png|thumb|right|150px|Admiral Ivernus]]
{{Quote|Welcome to Balmorra, hunter. Your target is the right impressive Admiral Ivernus, they call him "Admiral Untouchable." Spends all his time on a fancy flagship surrounded by armed soldiers. Can't kill what you can't touch, hunter. You gotta lure Admiral Ivernus off his flyin' fortress and down to Balmorra.|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="TOR:TBT" />}}
The first Hunt target for the Hunter was [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ivernus]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], an important Imperial official who never leaves his ship. However, Mako was able to determine a weak link through Major [[Pirrell]], who looking for help.<ref name="TOR:TBT" /> But upon disembarking, they was accosted by Vexx's siblings, who were told by Blood that the Hunter shot Vexx in the back and killed Braden when he discovered the Hunter's "crime". The Hunter was able to convince the two that Tarro was deceiving them.<ref name="TOR:PA" />

The Hunter soon met with Pirrell, who was looking to discredit his superior and gain the favor of Ivernus.<ref name="TOR:PA" /> He had the Hunter run jobs across Balmorra to that effort,<ref name="TOR:CatDF">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Chaos at the Droid Factory|Balmorra}}</ref><ref name="TOR:DwtQ">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Down with the Queen|Balmorra}}</ref><ref name="TOR:BaS">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Bait and Switch|Balmorra}}</ref> ultimately succeeding in bringing Ivernus away from the protection of his warship. But much to Pirrell's surprise, Ivernus was looking to execute him for his incompetence, before Pirrell's [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] slave was revealed to be a rival bounty hunter after Ivernus. The Hunter is able to kill both the rival and Ivernus at the same time. The Hunter also chose to spare Pirrell, considering his cowardice. The Imperial promised to put all the blame on the Cathar.<ref name="TOR:MtA" />

====Nar Shaddaa====
[[File:Eidolon2.png|thumb|right|150px|The Eidolon]]
{{Quote|Welcome to Nar Shaddaa, hunter--sleaziest place in the galaxy. Your target is the Eidolon, a professional assassin with a right scary reputation. Branded himself as the assassin who could kill absolutely anybody. For the right price, of course. Spent several years proving it, too.|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />}}
The second target was a private security consultant called the [[Eidolon (assassin)|Eidolon]], a former assassin, on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:TEoME" /> The Hunter and Mako got in contact with Geleren, a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] slaver, and Mako's old friend [[Anuli]],<ref name="TOR:EB">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Economic Boom|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> who assisted them in sabotaging Eidolon Security.<ref name="TOR:EB" /><ref name="TOR:IE">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Industrial Espionage|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> Unfortunately, the Eidolon retaliated, killing both Geleren and Anuli before facing the Hunter to a duel.<ref name="TOR:IE" /> The latter prevailed. Despite the Hutt Cartel was offering a significant sum for the live capture of the Eidolon, the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] pleaded to be granted a mercy killing, rather than be subjected to the mercies of the Hutts. The Hunter granted his wish.<ref name="TOR:PC" />

====The auction====
{{Quote|We don't have a lot of time, so I'll be brief. The sanctity of the Great Hunt has been compromised. Seems a slicer got ahold of the Great Hunt's target list and intends to auction those names to the highest bidders. Exposure like that would destroy the Great Hunt. I need this dealt with quickly and discretely.|Huntsmaster Assistant [[Lek]]|<ref name="TOR:ADA">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|A Dangerous Auction|Hutta}}</ref>}}
The Hunter was soon called upon by Huntsmaster Assistant [[Lek]] to retrieve the list of Great Hunt targets that had been stolen and was being auctioned on Hutta. The Hunter managed to interrupt the auction and retrieved the list, as well as learning that Blood had leaked the list.<ref name="TOR:ADA" />

====Sands of Tatooine====
[[File:Tyresius_Lokai.png|thumb|right|150px|Tyresius Lokai]]
{{Quote|You're after Tyresius Lokai, a scoundrel who's been on the galaxy's most wanted list forever.''"<br />"''"The" Tyresius Lokai? That smuggler cheated the Hutt Cartel, Exchange and Black Sun gangs out of a fortune.''"<br />"''"And he's been buying himself out of trouble ever since. Two days ago, your rival bounty hunter shot down Tyresius's ship over Tatooine but then lost him in the desert.|[[Crysta Markon]] and [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:TTT" />}}
The next target was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] fugitive named Tyresius Lokai, who ran afoul of many criminal cartels. Unfortunately, Tyresius was tipped off by Blood and was shot down over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR:TTT" /> The Hunter eventually cornered the sly Devaronian at his ship. Tyresius offered a compromise: the Hunter can shoot a double, which could fool even Lek, and Tyresius can work for the Hunter under a new pseudonym, [[Gault Rennow]]. The Hunter accepted.<ref name="TOR:CASE" />

====The Durasteel Duke====
[[File:Corwin.png|thumb|right|150px|The Durasteel Duke]]
{{Quote|Welcome to Alderaan, hunter. Former tourist capital of the Core Worlds. Your target here's a nobleman nicknamed "The Durasteel Duke," on account of his knack for stayin' alive. Over a thousand assassins have come and gone tryin' to put the duke to bed, but he ain't met you yet, right?|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="TOR:TAT" />}}
The fourth target was Duke [[Corwin]] Organa, aka the Durasteel Duke. The Hunter sought out the assistance of the [[House Girard]] in tracking down Corwin, the same house which ensure the downfall of his rival.<ref name="TOR:StP">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Spiking the Punch|Alderaan}}</ref> Ultimately, the Hunter cornered the Duke at an [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]] estate. But much to the Hunter's surprise, Corwin was discovered to be dead and his sister was posing as him. The Organas then handed over Corwin's body.<ref name="TOR:KfaD" />

====Return to Nar Shaddaa====
{{Quote|Tarro mustn't win the Great Hunt. Don't let his example lead others down the easy path. Keep honor alive among my people... show them that the old traditions, the code of the warrior, is worthy of defending.|[[Hedarr Soongh]], to the Hunter|<ref name="TOR:HR">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Honor Regained|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
[[File:Hedarr_Soongh_and_Sedyn_Kyne.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Hedarr Soongh confronts Sedyn Kyne.]]
The Hunter was soon contacted by [[Hedarr Soongh]], a previous Champion of the Great Hunt, who informed the Hunter that Blood's allies are gathering on Nar Shaddaa to discuss how to deal with the Hunter. The Hunter and Mako came face-to-face with Braden's murderer, [[Sedyn Kyne]], and, with Soongh's supervision, engaged in an honorable [[Taung blood duel]] that the Hunter won. Unfortunately, the other Mandalorians refused Soongh's demand to let the Hunter finish the Great Hunt in peace, and shot the elderly man in the chest. After the Hunter finished off the rest of Blood's lackeys, with his dying breath, Soongh pleaded the Hunter not to let the Mandalorian fall off the path of honor.<ref name="TOR:HR" />

====The final round====
{{Quote|You've made this all look so easy, how about something serious for your final mark? You ready for this, sugar? You're hunting Jedi Master Kellian Jarro, the "Mandalorian Killer" himself. [...] At the Battle of Coruscant, Jarro single-handedly gave over a hundred Mandalorian soldiers the "Big Push."|[[Crysta Markon]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:TMK" />}}
The last target of the Great Hunt was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kellian Jarro]], who was renowned for the most Mandalorian kills during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. Crysta instructed the Hunter to eliminate Jarro and disable the Republic cruiser [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']]<nowiki>'</nowiki>s hyperdrive output regulator, which would cause the ship to be destroyed once it jumps to hyperspace. She also let slip that Blood is already on his way to taking on Jarro.<ref name="TOR:TMK" />

[[File:Tarro_Blood_in_cell.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tarro Blood begs the Hunter to release him from the cell.]]
The Hunter located the ''Aurora'' was the Hunter's ship was caught in a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. Meeting with a Republic security team, the Hunter learned that Blood was captured by Jarro and convinced him that the Hunter was his accomplice. The Hunter refused to be taken into custody and fought through the ship, before finding Blood in the brig. Blood demanded that he be released so they can settle their feud, claiming that it's what both Soongh and Braden would've wanted. Mako retorted that Braden would've wanted to see Blood just as he is, undeserving of an honorable death. The Hunter agreed to leave Blood in his cell and walked away, ignoring the screams of the pathetic Mandalorian.<ref name="TOR:TMK" />

[[File:Jarro_and_Noori.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Thendys Noori contemplates the body of her dead master Kellian Jarro.]]
The Hunter came face-to-face with Jarro on the bridge, who then attempted to use a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to subdue the Hunter just as he did Blood, but found that his opponent had a much stronger will. The Jedi then attempted reasoning, stating that there's no profit in revenge but the Hunter wouldn't back down. After the Hunter killed Jarro, his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Thendys Noori]] encouraged the Hunter to kill her, which the bounty hunter did.<ref name="TOR:TMK" />

After narrowly escaping the ''Aurora''{{'s}} destruction,<ref name="TOR:TMK" /> the victorious Hunter returned to Dromund Kaas and was proclaimed a Grand Champion of the Great Hunt.<ref name="TOR:HtCH" />
